question: Your team is extending the process_refund tool of the customer support resolution agent. Before you change its handler, you want Claude Code to locate every test file in the repository. All of these files follow the naming pattern *.test.ts and sit in many nested directories. Which built-in tool selection fits this step best?

options.text: Use Grep to search the contents of all files for test framework calls such as describe or expect.
options.reason: The guide says Grep searches file contents for patterns. The task is to match file names, which the guide assigns to Glob.

options.text: Use Read on every file in the repository and keep the files whose names end in .test.ts.
options.reason: The guide says Read is for full file contents and warns against reading all files upfront. Glob finds files by name pattern directly.

options.text: Use Read on the root package file and follow its imports until all test files have been found.
options.reason: The guide uses Read to follow imports when tracing code flows. Locating files by a naming pattern is a Glob task.

options.text: Use Glob with the pattern **/*.test.ts to match file paths by name across all nested directories.
options.reason: The guide names Glob as the tool for finding files that match naming or extension patterns, such as **/*.test.tsx.
